sections.heading: A form page is read-only because it is locked
sections.text: Data managers lock or freeze form pages after review. A locked page shows a padlock icon and opens read-only. Site users cannot unlock pages; an unlock must be requested from the study data manager through the query process.

steps.text: Record the form name, visit, and the reason the user needs to edit the locked page.
Share this article section describing how to request an unlock from the study data manager.

information_needed.prompt: Name of the form page and visit as shown in the page header.

stop_conditions.text: Do not unlock form pages for the user; route every unlock request to the study data manager.
